2. takes Item-A and Item-B (two items)

4. carries Item-B into hallway

The action of taking Item-B is missing in beat1 but maybe implied by beat2? Beat2 says carries Item-B into hallway, which implies he had taken it earlier. But rule 1: Every assigned concrete action must be explicitly narrated; a later state does not prove an omitted action. So "takes Item-B" was not explicitly narrated. It's only implied by carrying.
